entries.label: Plateformes FOB
entries.scene: MGSV Forward Operating Base at sea in clear daylight, using the actual reference industrial platform architecture. Several tall ochre-orange cylindrical service towers arranged closely, metal catwalk rings around them, dark utility panel strips, steel stairs, cranes with orange counterweight bodies and pale green long booms, yellow and grey guardrails, deep blue ocean and flat distant horizon. No land or city. Build one broad level grey metal combat deck across foreground, with the distinctive orange towers visible behind it at the reference scale. No circular pit in the combat deck; background catwalk shapes may remain. Preserve realistic steel and weathering, bright blue/ochre color balance. No soldier, no icons, no HUD.
entries.prompt: Create exactly ONE wide 16:9 static fighting-game background plate for CQC, based closely on the supplied actual game screenshot references. MGSV Forward Operating Base at sea in clear daylight, using the actual reference industrial platform architecture. Several tall ochre-orange cylindrical service towers arranged closely, metal catwalk rings around them, dark utility panel strips, steel stairs, cranes with orange counterweight bodies and pale green long booms, yellow and grey guardrails, deep blue ocean and flat distant horizon. No land or city. Build one broad level grey metal combat deck across foreground, with the distinctive orange towers visible behind it at the reference scale. No circular pit in the combat deck; background catwalk shapes may remain. Preserve realistic steel and weathering, bright blue/ochre color balance. No soldier, no icons, no HUD. Camera at standing human eye level facing sideways across the combat lane, cinematic but readable with a level ground line across the lower fifth. Faithful materials, landmark proportions and original game palette; reconstruct as a clean detailed game environment, not an unrelated concept art reinterpretation. A single coherent scene, no collage or panels, no typography, no logo, no interface, no characters, no vehicles or bosses. Full opaque background, sharp environmental detail.

notes: Tours orange, passerelles, grues et océan repris de la capture FOB.
